title: Sales Head - B2C & D2C
jobDescription:
We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Head
- B2C & D2C to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and market expansion. The candidate will be responsible for managing direct consumer sales, developing sales strategies, handling customer relationships, and leading the sales team to achieve business targets. Develop and implement effective B2C & D2C sales strategies to increase revenue and customer base. Generate leads through online and offline sales channels. Manage end-to-end customer sales cycle from lead generation to closure. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and yearly sales targets. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer behavior. Coordinate with marketing and operations teams for campaign execution. Prepare sales reports, MIS, and performance analysis. Train, mentor, and manage sales executives/team members. Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention. Handle escalations and resolve customer concerns professionally. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Good understanding of B2C & D2C sales processes. Target-driven and result-oriented mindset. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment. KPIs / Performance Metrics Monthly sales revenue. Customer acquisition numbers.

title: Customer Growth Manager (Key Account Manager)
jobDescription:
The Customer Growth Manager will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with existing key customers, ensuring customer satisfaction, increasing revenue, and identifying new business opportunities within assigned accounts. The role requires a customer-centric approach, strong relationship-building skills, and the ability to drive account growth through strategic engagement. Manage a portfolio of strategic and high-value customer accounts. Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers. Conduct regular business reviews and performance meetings with clients. Customer Growth & Revenue Expansion Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion initiatives. Identify opportunities to increase customer wallet share and business volume. Develop account growth plans and execute strategies to achieve targets. Ensure achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals. Customer Retention & Satisfaction Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Proactively address customer concerns and service issues. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery. Monitor customer feedback and implement improvement initiatives. Business Development Identify new opportunities within existing accounts and generate additional business. Collaborate with sales, operations, finance, and customer support teams to deliver customer solutions. Track market trends and competitor activities to recommend growth strategies. Reporting & Performance Management Maintain accurate account records and customer interactions in CRM. Prepare MIS reports, account performance reviews, and growth forecasts. Monitor KPIs related to revenue, retention, and customer engagement. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Revenue growth from existing accounts. Customer retention rate. Account expansion and upselling success. Customer satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS). Achievement of assigned revenue targets. Number of strategic customer engagements and reviews conducted. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or related field. MBA preferred. Experience 4-8 years of experience in Key Account Management, Customer Success, Business Development, or Sales. Experience in logistics, courier aggregation, e-commerce, Saa S, or related industries preferred. Skills Required Excellent client relationship management skills. Strong communication and negotiation abilities. Sales and business development acumen. Analytical and problem-solving skills. CRM and MS Office proficiency. Ability to manage multiple accounts and stakeholders effectively. Role Objective To drive customer retention, account growth, and long-term client partnerships by delivering exceptional customer experience and maximizing business opportunities within existing accounts. title: Logistics Operations Executive
jobDescription:
Manage end-to-end logistics operations including first mileand last-mile activities. Supervise to achieve operational targets and service excellence. Monitor operational performance, including TAT, SLA adherence, PDD, NDR, and exception management. Manage relationships with courier partners to ensure smooth execution. Analyze operational data and prepare MIS reports, dashboards, and performance reviews. Drive resolution of critical customer escalations and ensure timely closure. Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for service failures and implement corrective actions. Coordinate with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Finance, IT, and Customer Support. Implement and monitor SOPs, compliance standards, and operational controls. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Advanced knowledge of logistics operations and supply chain processes. Proficiency in MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, MIS reporting). Strong stakeholder and courier management skills. Excellent communication and escalation management skills. Experience: 2-4 years of experience in logistics, courier, e-commerce, or supply chain operations. Preferred Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
